load_dataset: load a FAISS benchmark dataset like sift1M, bigann, deep, music-100, or glove by name
DatasetCentroids: create a DatasetCentroids instance from an existing dataset and a precomputed IVF clustering index file
DatasetCentroids_get_groundtruth: compute ground-truth nearest neighbors for centroid-based dataset queries using faiss.knn
evaluate: run a FAISS index search on query vectors and print latency and recall at R@1, R@10, R@100
sanitize: convert a numpy array to a contiguous float32 array for FAISS compatibility
